diagnostics.message:
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
`kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner` references the AWSNodeTemplate `default` via `spec.providerRef.name = "default"`, but has no dependency on `kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template`. If the Provisioner is applied before the NodeTemplate exists, Karpenter cannot resolve the providerRef and node provisioning fails until the template appears; the ordering is only enforced operationally, not by any attribute reference or depends_on.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner references the AWSNodeTemplate named "default" via spec.providerRef.name, but that object is created by kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template. The two resources share no attribute reference or ordering (both only depend_on module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons), so Terraform may apply the Provisioner before its referenced node template exists, and Karpenter will fail to resolve providerRef when provisioning nodes.
